• SLA Isolation: Slow audit sink never throttles critical business paths.
• Message Store: Append-only immutable store with TTL/tiering.
• Audit History: Captures intermediate states across routing steps.
• Realization: LMAX Disruptor, Virtual Thread Async Tap, S3/Parquet.

div.span: Strict schema registry enforcement • Poison pill quarantine • Audit TTLs

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding-top: 741px; margin-left: 29px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #1E293B;

div.div:
Key Operations & Governance Principles:
• Zero-Intrusiveness: Wire Tap and Message History must execute asynchronously via bounded queues; dropping audit copies is strictly preferred to blocking production.
• W3C Causality: Every asynchronous message boundary must propagate standard traceparent headers to reconstruct distributed DAG execution trees.
• Administrative Isolation: Control Bus commands operate on dedicated broker subjects/channels to prevent queue starvation during traffic surges.
• Controlled Redrive: Dead-letter redrive requires rate-limiting and deduplication fencing to prevent secondary thundering herd collapses.
